svg.title: Role column choosing board
svg.desc: Five options A to E for the first column of the README role table, each with the four roles.

g.title: Maren, the owner
g.desc: Head and shoulders of a cut-paper human on a soft round cream ground: dark hair in a bun held by a gold pin, a dark ink coat with one lapel folded to its gold lining, and one hand holding up a capped dark pen with a gold clip.

g.title: Sill, the advisor
g.desc: The top of a teal cut-paper letter folded in three, on a soft round cream ground: its pale flap stands open above two dot eyes and a straight mouth, it has no arms, and a small bubble holding a single teal dot shows it answering.

g.title: Brae, the coordinator
g.desc: A wide amber cut-paper folder on a soft round cream ground: its top edge is folded over in a lighter amber, it has two dot eyes and a smile, a small mustard flag stands behind it, and a fan of violet task cards and one cream card shows in its front pocket.

g.title: Pim, a delegate
g.desc: A small light violet cut-paper droplet with a bent pale tip, on a soft round cream ground: two dot eyes, a belt of three small beads, and one arm holding up a paintbrush with a wooden handle and dark bristles.

g.title: Odet, a delegate
g.desc: A violet cut-paper square with a pale dog-eared corner and a small coral knotted ribbon, on a soft round cream ground: two dot eyes, a straight mouth, and one arm holding a dark spool whose thread trails away.

g.title: Fenn, a delegate
g.desc: A deep violet cut-paper box lid, four flaps round a square panel, on a soft round cream ground: two dot eyes and a smile, a small mustard flag standing behind it, and one arm holding a brighter violet set square.
